camel_example: aliyun sas UpdateHoneypotPreset --region cn-hangzhou --HoneypotImageName metabase --Meta 'portrait_option_:true,_burp_:_open' --Lang zh --PresetName apc_web_python --HoneypotPresetId 'f75eddce-e9d3-4a88-af95-b10b6f65xxxx'
description_en: Modifies the configuration of a specified honeypot template
description_zh: 更改指定的蜜罐模板配置
kebab_example: aliyun sas update-honeypot-preset --honeypot-image-name metabase --preset-name apc_web_python --honeypot-preset-id f75eddce-e9d3-4a88-af95-b10b6f65xxxx --meta portrait_option_:true,_burp_:_open --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateHoneypotPreset

parameters.help_en: The name of the honeypot image
parameters.name: honeypot_image_name

parameters.help_en: The custom name of the honeypot template
parameters.name: preset_name

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the honeypot template.
>You can call the [ListHoneypotPreset](~~ListHoneypotPreset~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
蜜罐模板唯一ID。
>调用[ListHoneypotPreset](~~ListHoneypotPreset~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: honeypot_preset_id

parameters.help_en:
The custom parameters of the honeypot template. The value is a JSON string that contains the following fields:
- **portrait_option**: social tracing
- **burp**: Burp countermeasure
- **trojan_git**: Git countermeasure
parameters.help_zh:
蜜罐模板自定义参数，格式为JSON格式的字符串。包含以下字段：
- **portrait_option**：社交溯源
- **burp**：Burp反制
- **trojan_git**：Git反制
parameters.name: meta

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content in the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：

- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
parameters.name: lang
